_doc: DESIGN-LANGUAGE-1 experiments: R&D for design as data. Ideas (wild and blue-sky welcome) are promoted to experiments; experiments are decided by the pre-registered rule below, never by opinion. Consumed by foundation/design.py (design experiments --check|--assign|--evaluate) and read by the design-manager role each tick.

policy.bucketing: sha256(experiment|visitor) modulo arms: sticky, equal split, nothing stored
policy.no_peeking: a verdict is computed only after min_sample_per_arm; before it the answer is continue
policy.kept_when: variant beats control on the metric (p below alpha) and every guard metric holds; otherwise control stays and the reason is recorded
policy.sources: the metric comes from first-party cookieless analytics (seed/analytics); a surface with no beacon cannot run an experiment and gets the beacon first
policy.after_verdict: kept: the variant becomes the product default in doctrine/design.json in the same change; every verdict writes its idea back to `ideas` with what was learned

experiments.hypothesis: A sans display face on the front door reads as more practical to builders than the serif and raises the share who start the interview.
The compact density lets a reader find the failing loop faster than the regular density.

ideas.idea: The interview pill bar becomes the only element above the fold; the page theme is chosen by the first spoken sentence (the accent is inferred from the idea's domain).
ideas.blast_box: a throwaway /lab route behind a flag; never the front door
ideas.promote_when: the interview start rate is measured for two weeks and the inferred accent passes derive

ideas.idea: A product's accent drifts with its own health (calm cool when every loop closes, warm when a clock is late), always inside the contrast-proven range.
ideas.blast_box: the cockpit only, one accent step, never the status colours
ideas.promote_when: a guard shows no rise in misreads of good and bad

ideas.idea: Each tenant system gets a generated mark from its loop graph, drawn by brand/tools/generate.py.
ideas.blast_box: generated files under a tenant folder

ideas.idea: Replace the fixed type scale with a clamp()-based fluid scale holding the same ratios.
ideas.promote_when: reading-time analytics exist for that surface

ideas.idea: A model of a different family critiques rendered phone screenshots of every changed surface against the invariants and files findings.
ideas.blast_box: advisory only until its false-positive rate is measured
ideas.promote_when: the first 20 critiques are scored against the lint
